name: MPII Human Pose Dataset
description: A benchmark dataset of images of people engaged in everyday activities, annotated with 2D human body joint positions for articulated human pose estimation. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Andriluka, M., Pishchulin, L., Gehler, P., & Schiele, B. (2014). 2D Human Pose Estimation: New Benchmark and State of the Art Analysis. IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 3686–3693. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2014.471

license.identifier: Custom MPII dataset terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The dataset is provided under its own terms rather than a standard SPDX-identified license. Review the current MPII dataset terms and any underlying image rights before use or redistribution.
